To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) double JPEG compression can be accurately detected with a support vector machine classifier and a feature vector formed by histograms of discrete cosine transformation coefficients; (b) the maximum-likelihood estimator can be used for accurate estimation of primary quality factor; (c) the detection of double compression and estimation of primary quality are important for construction of targeted and blind stego detectors for JPEG images.
• We propose an accurate and robust method for the detection double-compression in JPEG images.

(1) the detection of double-compression in JPEG images can be achieved with an accuracy of over 99% with a false-positive rate of less than 0.1%; and (2) the proposed maximum-likelihood estimator for the primary quality factor can be used to accurately estimate the primary quality factor of a double-compressed image with a mean squared error of less than 1%.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of methods for detection of double-compression and estimation of the primary quality in JPEG images.
the development of a method for detection of double-compression in digital images and a method for the estimation of primary JPEG quality factor from double-compressed images.
